amount.description: What it settled, in the bill's currency.

date.description: The day it settled the bill.

payment_number.description: The payment's number; for an application, the other document's: the credit's on a bill, the bill's on a credit.

realised_fx.description: The realised gain (positive) or loss (negative) it made, in the base currency (ENG-41).

via.description: payment: a payment of bills; application: a supplier credit applied (FR-AP-03).

voided.description: true once the payment was voided: it no longer settles the bill.
